redemptionRules.unlockRequirement: Requires at least 3 wins before promo codes can be redeemed in-game.
steps: Launch Cameraman Tower Defense on Roblox.
Complete at least 3 matches (3 wins) to unlock code redemption privileges.
Click on the Shop icon located on the left-side HUD.
Scroll all the way down to the bottom of the Shop menu to locate the code redemption field.
Type or paste an active code exactly as shown (codes are case-sensitive) and click Redeem to receive free coins.
